company.name: Mezli
company.shortDescription: Great, affordable meals made by robots.
company.description: At Mezli, we're building "auto-kitchens", fully autonomous shipping-container restaurants that serve great, affordable meals for takeout and delivery.  While at Stanford, the three of us got fed up with having to either cook every day or spend $10 or more for healthy options like Chipotle, Sweetgreen, etc. So, we decided to democratize access to healthy, convenient food by building Mezli.

productsAndServices.description: Mezli provides meals prepared by robots, focusing on affordability and convenience.
